history.perspective: B31 - Navigation stack edge cases (deep stacks, tab switch mid-flow, duplicate pushes)
history.outcome: clean - zero navigation.push() usage anywhere, live-verified rapid-tap and tab-switch state preservation

history.perspective: B32 - Error boundaries / crash resilience against malformed data
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: zero error boundary coverage anywhere in the app - added ErrorBoundary.tsx wired around the whole provider tree in App.tsx. Live-verified via browser preview: forced a real render crash, confirmed fallback UI renders instead of a blank screen.

history.perspective: B33 - Bundle/APK size audit for Play Store
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: release builds shipped with R8 minify + resource shrinking both off. Installed expo-build-properties@~1.0.10 (SDK-54-matched version) and enabled both flags in app.json. Verified end-to-end via a real expo prebuild that gradle.properties picks up both flags correctly.

history.perspective: B34 - EAS build config correctness (production profile, permission minimalism, ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption accuracy)
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission present in the merged release manifest with zero legitimate use, coming from the base RN/Expo template not app.json. Added to android.blockedPermissions, verified stripped via a fresh expo prebuild. Also confirmed ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption:false is accurate (sync crypto is all standard AES-GCM/HKDF/HMAC/PBKDF2/SHA-256, exemption-eligible) and eas.json's production profile (app-bundle, autoIncrement) is already correct.
